sn4.12:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta's Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika's Park. Now on that occasion the Blessed One was teaching the Dhamma while surrounded by a large assembly.
sn4.12:1.2:
Then it occurred to Māra the Evil One: "This ascetic Gotama is teaching the Dhamma while surrounded by a large assembly. Let me approach the ascetic Gotama in order to confound them." Then Māra the Evil One approached the Blessed One and addressed him in verse: "Why now do you roar like a lion,
Confident in the assembly?
For there is one who's a match for you,
So why think yourself the victor?"
"The great heroes roar their lion's roar
Confident in the assemblies—
The Tathāgatas endowed with the powers
Have crossed over attachment to the world."
Then Māra the Evil One … disappeared right there.
